abilities.name: Minigun
abilities.description: Activate to have Basic Attacks against Heroes deal bonus damage equal to 2.5% of their maximum Health. Lasts 3 seconds.; 12; trait

fields.notes: Minigun duration starts at the first Basic Attack after activating the trait. Cooldown starts when the duration ends. Bonus damage from Minigun is dealt in a separate instance.

abilities.name: Overkill
abilities.description: Deal 552 damage to the target and 276 damage to nearby targets over 4 seconds. Reactivate to select a new target or direction. Can move and use Abilities while channeling.

fields.notes: Tychus can cancel Overkill by starting to Mount or casting Commandeer Odin. If the main target of Overkill dies while it's active, it will automatically retarget the closest enemy within its radius. If the main target is simply out of range, Overkill remains fixated to it until a new target is issued by reactivating the Ability.

abilities.name: Frag Grenade
abilities.description: Lob a grenade that deals 256 damage, knocking enemies away.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin
abilities.description: Call down an Odin to pilot. The Odin deals increased Damage, has 100% increased Basic Attack range, and uses different Abilities. The Odin has 25 Armor and lasts 23 seconds.; 100; 100; heroic

fields.type: Transformation, Defensive damage modifier, Status effect
fields.notes: Tychus is unable to act for 2.75 seconds while entering the Odin. During this time Tychus is Unstoppable. This delay is included in its duration. Activating Commandeer Odin immediately ends Minigun and Overkill. Cooldown starts immediately when the Ability is cast. Tychus cannot use Minigun and does not benefit from Sizzling Attacks while piloting Odin.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin - Annihilate
abilities.description: Fire the Odin's cannons in a straight line, dealing 196 damage to everything in the path.

fields.notes: 1) Annihilate 's search area is a line of 7 circles with 1.8 radius, which centers are 2.5 units apart. Impact on each sub-area is delayed by 0.1 seconds from the previous, but a target cannot be hit more than once per cast. Does not stack with other positive Armor effects. Other defensive damage modifiers may stack. Only available while Commandeer Odin is active.

abilities.name: Commandeer Odin - Ragnarok Missiles
abilities.description: Launches a volley of missiles at target area, dealing 132 damage and Slowing enemy Movement Speed by 30% for 2 seconds.

fields.notes: Only available while Commandeer Odin is active.
Only available while Commandeer Odin is active.

abilities.name: Drakken Laser Drill
abilities.description: Call down a Laser Drill to attack nearby enemies, dealing 142 damage every second. Reactivate to assign a new target. Lasts 22 seconds. Drakken Laser Drill ; 100; 100; heroic

fields.notes: Drakken Laser Drill has a 2 second spawn delay. This delay is included in its duration. Cooldown starts immediately when the Ability is cast. Laser Drill 's attack is a channeled beam that deals Spell Damage.
